Neither it nor \\u0060ConcludeOneAsync\\u0060 checks that the task\\u0027s assignee login is this install\\u0027s \\u0060login\\u0060, or that the task belongs to this owner. A teammate\\u0027s replicated auto-created review can therefore be recalled, and even abandoned, by this install\\u0027s daemon.\\nScenario: Brian and Ryan are both requested on a pull request, and each install mints its own review. Ryan\\u0027s task replicates to Brian\\u0027s node with \\u0060AutoPrReviewAssigneeLogin = \\u0022ryan\\u0022\\u0060. Brian is then removed as a reviewer. Brian\\u0027s sweep sees the pull request drop out of his review-requested list and finds a removal event for his own login on the timeline. It then appends \\u0060PullRequestReviewAssignmentRecalled\\u0060 to Ryan\\u0027s task. If that task is still Published or Queued, it also appends \\u0060TaskAbandoned\\u0060.
